accusative object coordinated with preceding name in the yoginī list; proper name of a yoginī
bahuvrīhi/tatpuruṣa-based qualifier: vahni-koṇa (fire corner) + gā (going/dwelling), locating the named yoginīs

items.question: Which yoginīs are assigned to the fire-corner in the eightfold worship?
premises: The mantra-practitioner is enjoined to worship an eightfold group of yoginīs.
The enumeration continues with Rākṣasī and Vīrakumārī as objects of worship.
These two are specified as dwelling in the fire-corner.
items.inference: Rākṣasī and Vīrakumārī are the yoginīs to be worshipped in the fire-corner as part of the eightfold set.
uncertainties: Whether vahnikoṇagām qualifies both preceding names or primarily the nearest is not explicitly marked.
items.plain_english: One should worship Rākṣasī and Vīrakumārī, who dwell in the fire-corner.
